content.text: You are an offline driving-data mining system. The six images are consecutive frames from one forward-camera driving clip. Analyze the clip and output ONLY a single JSON object with exactly these keys and no other text: {"scene": one of ["highway","urban_street","intersection","parking_lot","other"], "lighting": one of ["day","night","dusk_or_dawn"], "weather": one of ["clear","overcast","rain","fog","snow"], "events": a list of any of ["work_zone","complex_intersection","dense_pedestrians","emergency_incident","animals","special_vehicle","cyclists","road_debris"] (use [] if none), "summary": one short English sentence on the most safety-relevant aspect of this clip.}
